tooltip.text: The stateCode from the State Table that is used to represent a running state. Should match the Asset Config Run Code
Running PLC State Code as configured in Asset Configuration

props.text: The Simulator will issue the "stateCode" to the asset's State tag for the specified "duration" (in minutes). When complete, it will loop back to the beginning of the list.

config.script:
if event is None: return
	updates = {event['column']: event['value']}
	updatedDataset= system.dataset.updateRow(self.view.custom.stateTable, event['row'], updates)
	path = self.view.custom.asset.mqttPath+"/SimProperties/State Table"
	system.tag.writeAsync(path, updatedDataset)
